messages:
maria: FYI customer Storix opened a dispute – invoice https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-02 shows ~3x tokens vs their dashboard. They attached screenshots and say spike happened between 00:00-02:00 UTC. Can we triage?

devin: tagging finance @devin. Do we have a quick ledger check first? can you paste the invoice ID and their account id?

maria: acct_storix_84, invoice INV-2026-02. They included sample request IDs: req_8f3a, req_8f3b, req_8f3c. Customer asserts the dashboard totals (daily tokens) are ~120k but invoice shows 360k.

alex: :eyes: possible double-ingest or billing job aggregation window bug. Any recent deploys to metering/ingest last night?

jess: I rolled metering aggregator v2.1.4 at 2026-02-14T23:45Z — small batching change. Could be related. I'll check the reconcile job logs.

billing-bot: Provisional credit template available. To issue provisional credit, post reason + amount and link to ticket.

devin: Finance needs provisional credit amount suggestion. If invoice triple-counted, propose crediting the difference: 240k tokens * rate. What is the token unit price on this invoice?

maria: Rate is $0.00005 per token on this plan. If we refund the overage: 240,000 * 0.00005 = $12.00. Recommend provisional credit $12 while we investigate.

alex: Repro steps I'm running now: 1) query ledger row counts for acct_storix_84 between 2026-02-14T00:00Z and 2026-02-15T00:00Z; 2) match ingestion event ids (req_8f3a etc.) to raw events; 3) check if dedupe key was unset during the deploy window. SQL I used:```sql
SELECT bucket, sum(tokens) as tokens, count(*) as events
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id='acct_storix_84' AND ts >= '2026-02-14' AND ts < '2026-02-15'
GROUP BY bucket;
```

alex: initial run shows ledger records ~360k tokens for that day. Raw events table has duplicate delivery for req_8f3a and req_8f3b (two rows each). Looks like a replay produced duplicate events.

jess: Huh — the aggregator change toggled `dedupe_key = NULL` for streaming reconnects when a batch boundary coincided with midnight. We have a fix in PR #492 but didn't roll back. That would cause duplicates to be counted into the daily bucket.

maria: Good find. Customer-facing next steps? They want immediate credit and confirmation we fixed root cause.

devin: Finance approves provisional credit of $12.00 pending final reconciliation. Create a revrec note with: "Provisional credit for duplicate-counting on invoice INV-2026-02; root cause: aggregator dedupe regression (deploy v2.1.4). Credit issued pending final audit."

maria: I'll send Storix a message: "We've issued a provisional credit of $12.00. Root cause suspected and fix deployed. We'll confirm final adjustment after audit."

billing-bot: Record created: CREDIT-2009-STX-01, amount $12.00, status: provisional. Linking to invoice INV-2026-02.

alex: FYI I pushed hotfix (re-enable dedupe_key) at 2026-02-15T01:12Z — aggregator v2.1.5. Will monitor for replayed events. Also ran a dedupe pass to tag duplicates with `duplicated=true` (one-time cleanup).

jess: I will backfill reconciliation script to remove duplicates from the billing aggregation for that night and produce a verified delta. ETA 2 hours.

devin: After verification, we'll convert provisional credit to final refund and post revrec code: REVREC-2026-02-INV-07. Finance will close once ledger adjustments are posted.

maria: Messaging to customer sent (copied here): "We've applied a provisional credit of $12.00 to INV-2026-02 while we complete a reconciliation. Root cause traced to an aggregator dedupe regression during a deploy; a hotfix has been deployed and duplicates are being removed. We'll follow up with the final invoice confirmation within 48 hours." :thumbsup:

maria: tagging followups: @devin please confirm when revrec code posted, @jess please attach the reconciliation diff when done, @alex please monitor for any other accounts with spikes between 23:30-01:30 UTC.

billing-bot: Action checklist: [X] provisional credit created CREDIT-2009-STX-01; [ ] reconciliation diff file; [ ] final credit/refund applied; [ ] revrec posted.

jess: Reconciliation done — delta shows we should reduce invoice by 240,000 tokens. Patch output attached: https://internal.redwood.ai/recon/recon-2009008765-diff.csv

devin: Revrec posted: REVREC-2026-02-INV-07. Final refund $12.00 applied to customer account and invoice updated. Finance closes case after verifying GL entries.

maria: Closing note to thread and customer: confirmed final adjustment and revrec posted. Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick response and transparency." Closing ticket. :party_parrot:

alex: I'll add a monitor to detect sudden daily:hourly ratio > 2.5 to catch similar regressions.

maria: Great — thanks all.
